name: My Account Custom Fields For WooCommerce
author: SysBasics

sections.description:
Add/Manage My account custom fields for your woocommerce my account edit page.show dashboard notices and collect required information from user.

Upgrade to pro

Check Live Demo for Pro version features

WooCommerce My Account Fields Plugin lets you create new fields into your WooCommerce Account Details endpoint within my account page and you can also create dashbaord notices to collect required data from users. Plugin support 15 types of widely used custom fields with conditional field visiblity , role based visibility and much more.

Modify My Account Fields as well as collect required data from user
You should be able to hide the core fields like change password , email , display name , first name and last name on My Account page plus you can add new custom fields with tons of options, plugin supports 15 type of widely used custom fields , Optionally you can display dashboard notice unless user enters required information.

15 type of field support for Account fields

Get all collected field details into WooCommerce Users Admin UI page

Modify dashboard notice way you want

Show/hide WooCommerce My Account Fields Conditionaly (Pro Feature)

conditionally show/hide WooCommerce My Account fields based on values of other fields plus based on other factors like role/user etc

Show Additional custom fields on WooCommerce Registration Form

Plugin also support all 15 types of custom fields on registation form as well, same can be synced with my account fields plus admin can view it into users admin page.

SysBasics My Account Fields Pro For WooCommerce Changelog

For changelog visit SysBasics My Account Fields Pro For WooCommerce Changelog
